description: Audrey router decisions: the original ten-case feasibility set plus twenty-six unique expansion cases.

cases.prompt: Refactor this function to avoid the nested loop and explain the tradeoff
Why does my Postgres query plan switch to a seq scan above ~10k rows?
Write a Python decorator that retries with exponential backoff
Walk me through whether it is cheaper to rent or buy given 6% rates
Compare the tradeoffs between event sourcing and CRUD for an audit trail
If a train leaves at 3pm going 60mph and another at 4pm going 80mph…
What is the capital of Australia?
Summarise what happened with the Voyager 2 plasma instrument
Give me a packing list for three days of winter camping
Draft a polite email declining a meeting invitation
Implement an LRU cache in Python with O(1) get and put operations
Debug this FastAPI endpoint: its upstream timeout is caught but clients still receive HTTP 500
Rewrite this correlated SQL subquery using a window function
Add HTTP byte-range support to this file download route
Fix the TypeScript type error caused by this discriminated union narrowing
Write a pytest regression test for two requests racing to claim the same row
Optimize this pandas groupby so it does not iterate over every row in Python
Create a Rust parser for a log line containing a timestamp, level, and message
Migrate this Pydantic v1 validator to the Pydantic v2 API
Analyze whether a durable queue or an in-memory channel better fits a job that must survive restarts
Review this API design and identify where ownership checks could be bypassed
Prove that the square root of two is irrational
Given frequent reads and rare writes, determine whether these records should be normalized or denormalized
Evaluate these timing clues and decide which failure most likely caused the restart loop

Draft a short agenda for a weekly team check-in
Who wrote The Left Hand of Darkness?
Give me a simple vegetarian chili recipe for four people
Rephrase this note so it sounds friendly and concise
List the seven continents in alphabetical order
Write a haiku about the first snow of winter
